info.name: spotify Remix - Music Service
info.description: Complete API surface for the single Music microservice (catalog, streaming/media, playback, queue, library, playlist, podcast, lyrics, search, temporary subscription, analytics, admin, share). Auth/User/Payment/Notification are separate existing services and are NOT included here. No API Gateway - every request hits the Music Service directly.
